ang-001.voice: There’s bad blood between us. Nothing can fix it now.
ang-001.situation: Not realizing that a gift can soften a long-standing grudge.
ang-001.note: Jacob met his estranged brother Esau with gifts, and the old enmity melted.

ang-002.voice: You’re doing the right thing. You’re allowed to be angry about it.
ang-002.situation: Irritation that flares up even while you’re trying to live rightly.

ang-003.voice: Twist the story a little. They deserve it.
ang-003.situation: Anger tempting you to misrepresent someone.

ang-004.voice: Did you hear what they said about you?
ang-004.situation: Rage stirred up by gossip or a secondhand report.

ang-005.voice: Tell them exactly what you think of them.
ang-005.situation: Wanting to lash out at someone with insults.

ang-006.voice: Remember the hateful thing they said?
ang-006.situation: Replaying the scene of someone speaking against you.
ang-006.note: Evagrius quotes John of Thebes: hatred over money or food can fade, but hatred over honor and reputation is hard to uproot.

ang-007.voice: No one can really be that humble. It’s not human.
ang-007.situation: Believing true gentleness and humility are impossible.

ang-008.voice: How dare they insult me like that?
ang-008.situation: Not seeing that insults can be a test God permits.
ang-008.note: When Shimei cursed King David, David refused to strike back: perhaps the LORD would see his distress and repay him with good.

ang-009.voice: I want to know God’s ways, but I won’t be humbled.
ang-009.situation: Wanting to grow in faith while skipping humility.

ang-010.voice: They’re up to something. Add it to the list.
ang-010.situation: Collecting suspicions and pretexts against people.

ang-011.voice: Listen to what everyone is saying about them.
ang-011.situation: Slander about someone clouding your mind with rage.

ang-012.voice: My nights are troubled, and I think my anger is the cause.
ang-012.situation: Discovering that rage feeds bad nights, and mercy and patience calm them.
ang-012.note: Evagrius noticed that frightening dreams often come from the turmoil of anger, and fade through mercy and patience.

ang-013.voice: Sing about patience. You’re furious, but sing it anyway.
ang-013.situation: Feeling like a hypocrite praying words you aren’t living.

ang-014.voice: They’re lazy, rude, and never do what they should.
ang-014.situation: Building a case against someone in your head.

ang-015.voice: Fight them on this. It matters.
ang-015.situation: Wanting to quarrel over things that won’t last.

ang-016.situation: Wanting to call down harm on someone.

ang-017.voice: I can’t pray. I’m still furious with them.
ang-017.situation: Anger at someone spoiling your prayer.

ang-018.voice: This stupid animal won’t do what I want!
ang-018.situation: Losing your temper with an animal, or anything that won’t cooperate.

ang-019.voice: That’s it. That tiny thing was the last straw.

ang-020.voice: Set a trap for them. They’ll never see it coming.

ang-021.voice: Replay it again. Remember exactly what they said.
ang-021.situation: Resentment that keeps an old word alive long after the anger cools.

ang-022.situation: Anger uprooting your patience and pushing you to foolish acts.

ang-023.voice: Who are they to correct me?

ang-024.voice: Don’t let it go. Win the argument.
ang-024.situation: Being drawn into strife and unable to drop an argument.

ang-025.voice: It’s only a thought. As long as I don’t act on it, it’s fine.
ang-025.situation: Believing angry thoughts don’t matter, only actions.

ang-026.voice: Hang around with the angry ones. They tell it like it is.
ang-026.situation: Drawn to angry people and heated talk.

ang-027.voice: They did it to me. I’ll do it right back.
ang-027.situation: Wanting to hurt someone the way they hurt you.

ang-028.voice: Let my enemy go hungry. Serves them right.
ang-028.situation: Refusing kindness to someone who is against you, even in their need.

ang-029.voice: I’m boiling. Everyone is getting on my nerves.
ang-029.situation: Quick to flare up and grow bitter with people.

ang-030.voice: I have every reason to be angry, and I’m keeping them.
ang-030.situation: Clinging to reasons for anger rooted in comfort, wealth or status.

ang-031.voice: After all this, how can you still love them?
ang-031.situation: Trials wearing down your love for others.

ang-032.voice: Write them a message that will really sting.
ang-032.situation: Wanting to send hurtful words to someone who troubled you.

ang-033.voice: The anger that used to grip me has let go.
ang-033.situation: Thanking God that old anger no longer provokes you.

ang-034.voice: My own family attacks my faith, and I’m furious.
ang-034.situation: Anger at family who oppose you for following Christ.

ang-035.voice: I’m restless and bored, and they’re irritating me.
ang-035.situation: Restlessness turning into irritation with someone.

ang-036.voice: They hurt me again. Now I’ll never let it go.
ang-036.situation: A second offense locking in resentment from the first.

ang-037.voice: Hate them. Curse them. They’re your enemy.
ang-037.situation: Thoughts pushing you to hate and curse your enemies.

ang-039.situation: Anger bending the command to love into something smaller.

ang-040.voice: I’m too bitter to love anyone right now.
ang-040.situation: Anger hardening into bitterness against love itself.

ang-041.voice: Good. They’re suffering. They deserve it.
ang-041.situation: Secret pleasure at an enemy’s misfortune.

ang-042.voice: I won’t forget this. One day I’ll pay them back.
ang-042.situation: Holding a grudge and waiting to repay evil.

ang-043.voice: Take what you’re owed. Cheat them back if you have to.
ang-043.situation: Anger pushing you to take advantage of someone.

ang-044.voice: They mocked my station in life. I won’t stand for it.
ang-044.situation: Enraged when someone mocks your job, class or circumstances.

ang-045.voice: I can’t speak openly with them anymore.
ang-045.situation: Anger shutting down the honest, loving speech you once had.

ang-046.voice: I want deep spiritual insight, though I lose my temper easily.
ang-046.situation: Seeking spiritual depth while staying quick-tempered.

ang-047.situation: Grieved and annoyed by other people’s failings.

ang-048.voice: After all I did for them, they complain?
ang-048.situation: Anger at someone who is ungrateful for your kindness.

ang-049.voice: Don’t make peace. They’ll only do it again.
ang-049.situation: Shame, fear and pride disguised as reasons not to reconcile.
ang-049.note: Evagrius calls this the demon’s craftiness: it dresses up shame, fear and pride as sensible reasons.

ang-050.voice: So many things make me angry.
ang-050.situation: Anger spilling over into every kind of thought.

ang-051.voice: Why am I always the one serving everyone?

ang-052.voice: I’m so angry I could say anything, even about God.
ang-052.situation: Heated anger giving birth to blasphemy or deceit.

ang-053.voice: Evil for evil. That’s only fair.
ang-053.situation: Wanting to repay harm with harm.

ang-054.voice: God’s commands are about being right, not about love.
ang-054.situation: Anger twisting faith away from its goal of love.

ang-055.voice: I keep arguing with them in my head.
ang-055.situation: Imaginary arguments stirring up conflict in your mind.

ang-056.voice: My relatives turned on me because I follow Christ.
ang-056.situation: Anger at being persecuted by family for your faith.

ang-057.voice: They owe me, and they aren’t even trying to repay.
ang-057.situation: Anger at someone who hasn’t paid you back.

ang-058.voice: I want to be righteous, but I snap at people.
ang-058.situation: Seeking God’s righteousness while angering quickly.

ang-059.voice: I’m full of anger, but I want God’s wisdom.
ang-059.situation: Wanting wisdom while your mind is full of anger.

ang-060.voice: That rule against speaking ill of others isn’t fair.
ang-060.situation: Defending slander by questioning God’s law.

ang-061.voice: Insult for insult. Don’t bless them.
ang-061.situation: Refusing to answer abuse with blessing.

ang-062.voice: I fear God. I just can’t stand that person.

ang-063.situation: Hatred that turns murderous in the mind.

ang-064.voice: I love God. I just don’t love them anymore.
ang-064.situation: Saying you love God while hatred has replaced your love for someone.
